content.rendered:
Our school office will close on June 23rd and reopen on Monday, August 16th at 7:30 am – 3:30 pm. If you should need assistance during this time please contact our District Office (Monday – Thursday) at 503-825-5000. Their offices are located at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd.

If you need to register your student please click here to complete the enrollment process.

The first day of school for students grades 1 – 5 will be Wednesday, September 8th. Kindergarten orientation classes will begin on September 8th with more info to follow in regards to their schedule.

Enjoy your summer break and we will see you in September.
